create_tasknode: create a TaskNode to represent a task object placed on the agent task stack
create_playernode: create a PlayerNode to represent humans and agents that can affect the world
create_locationnode: create a LocationNode to represent a raw location as a point in space
create_chatnode: create a ChatNode to represent a chat utterance from another agent or human
create_programnode: create a ProgramNode to represent logical forms from the semantic parser
